name: Salaried Employment Card (Carte de Séjour -- Salarié)

requirements.blocker_text: An employer applies on the foreign worker's behalf for the salaried employment card; the labour ministry reportedly verifies no local candidate is available before granting it. Total timeline reported at 8+ weeks. No specific foreign-staff quota or percentage cap could be confirmed for Congo in this build (contrast Bolivia's 15% cap and Angola's 30% cap found earlier in this dataset) -- only a general 'labor market test' description, without a stated ratio.
requirements.fix_path: Secure a job offer from a Congo-registered employer willing to sponsor the salaried employment card and clear the labour ministry's local-candidate check.

sources.title: Openshores -- Republic of Congo work visas and employment cards: employer sponsorship, labour ministry local-candidate check, timeline

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Congo-Brazzaville). STATUS: DRAFT -- tier-3 sourced only (openshores.co); no Congolese government labour-ministry text could be fetched in this build (see visitor_visa.json notes on gov.cg fetch failures). work_rights set to 'restricted' since the card is employer-tied, not a general work authorization. pr_after_months/citizenship_after_months (120) are tied to the general 10-year continuous-residence gate found in the residence-card ladder (cg_long_term_residence.json) and the 10-year naturalization residency requirement (cg_citizenship_naturalisation.json), not a work-permit-specific accelerated rule -- this dataset found no separate, faster path from work permit to residency/citizenship.
